title: Potential Kerberoasting via Service Ticket Request with RC4 Encryption
author: Damir Sadikov
description:
Detects potential Kerberoasting activity by identifying Kerberos service
ticket (TGS) requests that use RC4 encryption (0x17). Modern Windows
environments default to AES, so a burst of RC4 ticket requests for accounts
with a Service Principal Name (SPN) is a strong indicator that an adversary
is harvesting tickets for offline cracking.
